title: nullary
description: Negative results intelligence for drug discovery — query measured failures via MCP.
summary: Negative results intelligence for drug discovery — query measured failures via MCP.
offersHint: Negative results intelligence for drug discovery — query measured failures via MCP. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.nullary.ai/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_failed_adcs
toolsPreview.description: ADCs that failed at any stage.

toolsPreview.name: search_adc_linker_failures
toolsPreview.description: ADC failures attributed to linker chemistry.

toolsPreview.name: search_failed_bispecifics
toolsPreview.description: Bispecifics that failed at any stage.

toolsPreview.name: search_mechanism_failures
toolsPreview.description: Approaches that failed for a mechanism (by target).

toolsPreview.name: search_target_history
toolsPreview.description: ALL failed approaches against a target across every modality.

toolsPreview.name: search_indication_history
toolsPreview.description: ALL failed approaches for an indication across every modality.

toolsPreview.name: search_pathogen_history
toolsPreview.description: Vaccine + antimicrobial + antibody failures for a pathogen.

toolsPreview.name: get_compound
toolsPreview.description: A compound (structure, name, max clinical phase) + its full negative profile across modalities/sources.

toolsPreview.name: get_finding_provenance
toolsPreview.description: Full provenance + detail for a single finding by id.

toolsPreview.name: get_target_landscape
toolsPreview.description: Target 'graveyard' / exhaustion index: how many distinct compounds/agents have been tried against a target and failed, broken down by modality and outcome. Answers 'how picked-over is this target?'. Accepts a gene symbol (e.g. EGFR) or a UniProt accession (e.g. P00533).

toolsPreview.name: list_top_targets
toolsPreview.description: Coverage browse: the most heavily-pursued ('graveyard') targets, ranked by recorded negative findings. Optional family filter (kinase, gpcr, protease, nuclear_receptor, ion_channel, transporter, phosphatase, other).

toolsPreview.name: list_models
toolsPreview.description: Summary of the Layer-1 inactivity-scoring model registry: how many per-target models, split by family, and median scaffold-split ROC-AUC.

toolsPreview.name: get_model_card
toolsPreview.description: Per-target Layer-1 model card: training counts and held-out scaffold-split metrics (ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, Brier, calibration). Accepts a gene symbol (e.g. EGFR) or UniProt accession (e.g. P00533).

toolsPreview.name: get_coverage
toolsPreview.description: Per-modality and per-source coverage stats (honest Phase-1 numbers).
